newsitem.title: USA: Fieldcrest Cannon stock falls on earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Fieldcrest Cannon stock falls on earnings warning.

text.p: The stock of Fieldcrest Cannon Inc. lost more than 10 percent of its value Wednesday after the maker of home furnishing products said it may report a loss for the third quarter.
Fieldcrest was off $2 at $16.25 in early trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
The company said it may break even or post a loss up to 25 cents a share in the third quarter, compared with earnings of $4.7 million, or 40 cents a share, a year earlier.

It said its results were hurt by lower sales and profit margins. Also, the cost of closing two towel plants and related towel plant consolidation will be about $1 million higher than originally anticipated, it said.
